issues.description: Identifier naming inconsistency: the abstract feeding method is referred to by two different names. The problem statement (UML and Part 1) specifies an abstract method named messageOnFeed(), while other sections of the problem statement (Part 2 animal tasks) refer to getFeedingSound(). The solution repository implements and calls messageOnFeed() (Animal.messageOnFeed and Farm.singFarmSongVerse usage). This mismatch can confuse students about which method to implement and which method the Farm should call when feeding animals or printing verses.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the feeding-method name consistent across the problem statement, template, and tests. Preferably update all references in problem_statement.md that mention getFeedingSound() to messageOnFeed() (to match the UML and the solution), and ensure all example text and task descriptions use messageOnFeed(). Alternatively, if you prefer getFeedingSound(), rename the abstract method and all usages in the solution and template to getFeedingSound(). Update the UML, example verses, and any test descriptions to the chosen name so students unambiguously know which method to implement and call.

issues.description: The concept is the animal feeding-sound method. In the problem statement text (task descriptions for Seal, Pig, Goat and the feedAllAnimals description) this method is named getFeedingSound(), while elsewhere in the same problem statement UML and in the reference implementation the abstract method is named messageOnFeed(). Specifically: problem statement (text) uses getFeedingSound(); problem statement (UML) shows messageOnFeed(); solution code defines Animal.messageOnFeed(), calls a.messageOnFeed() in Farm, and Seal/Pig/Goat implement messageOnFeed(). This inconsistency makes it unclear which method name students must implement and call (messageOnFeed() vs getFeedingSound()), which can block or confuse students when mapping requirements to the provided template and UML.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: update problem_statement.md to refer to messageOnFeed() everywhere (replace getFeedingSound() with messageOnFeed() in the Seal/Pig/Goat task lines and in the feedAllAnimals description) so it matches the UML and the provided/solution code. Alternatively, if you prefer getFeedingSound() as the canonical name, change the UML and all code (Animal, Farm, Seal, Pig, Goat) to use getFeedingSound() consistently.
